voices.text: The only way to face a problem is head-on.
Our victory is assured. Unless, of course, the Patron pairs me with a bunch of malcontents who refuse to pull their own weight. In which case, victory depends on how much extra burden I need to bear.
They think they know magic? Oh... I'll show 'em some magic..
Smash the bottle, smash their heads, smash the ritual!
I decide when, and where, I strike.
If I find someone on their own, God himself couldn't save 'em.
One black hole can make all the difference.
I don't have to be the fastest: just the most clever.
Simple plan: I grab 'em, you shoot 'em.
They'll be nothin' but ash when I'm through.
The lives of the weak are meant to sustain the lives of the strong.
There's a whole lotta people that don't got enough ''knives'' stuck in 'em.
Hurting them is fine, but ''vexing'' them is even better.
I don't fear pain. I weaponize it.
If they don't have an Achilles' heel, I'll make one.
